research_rationale: The complete strong official FR extract creates an indefinite Federal Financing Bank Advisory Council composed only of named federal officers, assigns advice and coordination duties, and directs Treasury administrative support. Its five substantive inventory units preserve every original command and all eight membership entries without treating short roster labels as standalone unsupported quotations. It contains no expiry, report-completion trigger, or executed repeal. EO 12379 section 15 formally revokes the whole order; the full actor supplies no delayed effective date or express savings, supporting August 17, 1982 as the formal revocation date. Mere inactivity mentioned in the actor preamble is not a legal termination mechanism. A held FACA extract supports the all-federal-committee exclusion, but its archive is an LFS pointer and its PDF hash lacks the required official-fixity match. The identified HEW departmental succession statute and the separately cited Bank statute also require source review. Those concrete statutory questions, rather than missing images for strong official EO extracts, keep the first-end and residual analysis partial. All same-1982-text machine-chain events labeled with other actors and earlier dates are rejected. Provisional no is unchanged; no first-end or whole-lifecycle readiness finding is asserted.
unresolved_material_gaps: STATUTORY_SCOPE_CUSTODY: the held full Public Law 92-463 extract contains the exclusion for committees composed wholly of full-time federal officers or employees and the two-year termination rule. Its opus archive is only a Git LFS pointer in this checkout and the cited PDF hash lacks an official-fixity MATCHED_BY_SHA256 entry. The all-federal membership strongly supports exclusion, but that statutory predicate is not promoted to authenticated source evidence.

MEMBERSHIP_SUCCESSION: original section 1 includes the Secretary of Health, Education, and Welfare. The Department of Education Organization Act, Public Law 96-88, is a concrete pre-1982 statutory lead for department redesignation and allocation/savings; its held original was not located. Whether this alters original membership wording without ending the continuing command must be checked before a complete first-end allocation.

FIRST_END_NOT_CLOSED: the only genuine located numbered-EO ending is EO 12379 section 15, effective August 17, 1982. The order itself has no sunset and inactivity alone does not end its legal authority. Nevertheless the identified statutory applicability and membership questions remain unclosed, so the formal cleanup date is recorded as a later event and is not automatically used for every first_end.

SAVINGS_AND_SEARCH: original section 2 identifies the Federal Financing Bank as separately established by Public Law 93-224. No explicit savings or independent future command appears in the complete original or revoker; the Act should be read to distinguish statutory Bank functions from this Council before closing residuals. The numbered-EO machine searches were read but are not sufficient for the identified statute questions, and the USC release stops at 2026-10-09.
